plugins.name: Armory
plugins.summary: Farm Armory stars and maintain passes with configurable game rotations.
plugins.overview: Armory rotates selected accounts through games that award pass XP. It can maintain passes in live mode and gives users a separate shop for spending credits.
plugins.integration: Shares its account and game plan with Games. Tracks busy accounts and yields to waiting Trader routes after in-flight work finishes.

plugins.name: Games
plugins.summary: Work toward game reward tiers or contribute XP to Armory passes.
plugins.overview: Games models the expected token cost of reaching the next reward tier and tracks bets, rewards and net results. The XP mode targets Armory progress. Actual results can vary.
plugins.integration: Uses routed requests for some games and sockets for crash and blackjack. Reads the Armory plan and avoids accounts being seated in battles.

plugins.name: Missions
plugins.summary: Claim completed missions and show progress on clicking accounts.
plugins.overview: Missions polls each healthy account, claims eligible mission rewards, and displays progress in a Missions tab and account-card badges.
plugins.integration: Uses staggered per-account scheduling and clears the cached account view when a run stops.

plugins.name: Monthly pass
plugins.summary: Claim monthly pass rewards from the free track, Pro track or both.
plugins.overview: Monthly pass checks selected clicking accounts on an interval and claims eligible tiers for the configured track.
plugins.integration: Uses the host account selector and a separate claiming switch. The Pass tab reports each account’s progress.

plugins.name: Rewards
plugins.summary: Claim ready rewards for rank, clicks, vault progress and other milestones.
plugins.overview: Rewards checks selected clicking accounts and claims redeemable reward-chain tiers. Its tab reports progress and recent results.
plugins.integration: Uses the same routed request and per-account scheduling APIs as the farmer’s other claimers.

plugins.name: Converter
plugins.summary: Turn inventory and capsules into tokens through configurable steps.
plugins.overview: Converter can sell cases and eligible skins, buy and open capsules, and optionally use accumulated tokens for Dragon Lore upgrades. Individual stages have their own controls.
plugins.integration: Uses cash and price limits, previews in Practice, and publishes which accounts are assigned to its upgrade step so Armory can skip them.

plugins.name: Opener
plugins.summary: Preview and open cases, capsules or collections across selected accounts.
plugins.overview: Opener can buy stock within a budget or use existing stock. It can handle drops, favourite rules and boosting effects. It tracks account XP and rank changes.
plugins.integration: Uses account busy markers during turns. The inspected beta also supports a Discord webhook for favourited drops when configured by the user.

plugins.name: Trader
plugins.summary: Move items and tokens between accounts using one-off trades or saved routes.
plugins.overview: Trader coordinates sender and receiver sockets. Both accounts must be in ZSB Hub and clicking. The plugin supports a practice mode and receipt checks.
plugins.integration: Serializes work per sender and receiver, and uses handoff requests when Armory is using an account needed for a route.

plugins.name: Effects
plugins.summary: Buy, sell, activate and queue special effects on selected accounts.
plugins.overview: Effects manages quantities and ammo reserves. A queue waits for the current effect in a family to finish, then activates the next configured effect.
plugins.integration: Uses account-scoped inventory and effect state. This version was present in the inspected beta and absent from the signed catalog snapshot.

plugins.name: Proxy manager
plugins.summary: Configure and test proxy or WireGuard routes for the farmer.
plugins.overview: Proxy manager publishes routes to the core, checks reachability and lets the user pin accounts to a route.
plugins.integration: Uses the host’s routing API and secret storage. WireGuard uses a local SOCKS bridge. Routes with a shared known exit IP share their capacity.

plugins.summary: Summarises daily gains, clicks, downtime and plugin activity in the Reports tab.
plugins.overview: Records account stats and activity in local daily reports, with a configurable history window and support for Auto Forge counters.
plugins.integration: Uses cached account stats and click events. Optionally reads saved counters from other plugins. It makes no network requests.
plugins.name: Daily reports
plugins.author: Gufries

plugins.summary: Opens Genesis and Dead Hand terminals and buys or passes offers using your rules.
plugins.overview: Applies configured float, pattern and rarity rules to terminal offers on selected accounts.
plugins.integration: Uses the Hub’s authenticated account requests and busy markers. Accepted offers spend account balance.
plugins.name: Terminal opener
plugins.author: Gufries

plugins.name: Skillmap Presets
plugins.summary: Preview and apply skill builds tailored to selected farm accounts.
plugins.overview: Builds for case clicking, click income, larger openings or a custom selection of skill IDs. Set cash and skill point budgets for each account.
plugins.integration: Uses each healthy account’s routed requests and busy markers. Rechecks prerequisites and verifies skill ownership after every purchase.
plugins.author: Rowan Kavanagh

plugins.name: Auto Grind
plugins.summary: Level a chosen account toward 5,000 Premier with one-click setup, repeated case opening and staged skillmaps.
plugins.overview: Select a case, save a per-account plan and watch progress toward a configurable Premier target. Reserve cash for the next unlocked skill and use the rest for cases.
plugins.integration: Sets the selected account to Hub Auto, uses its existing farming route and supports automatic enrollment from Routed Account Setup. Tested on Hub 1.2.8 and 1.2.11 desktop.
plugins.operation: Opt-in leveling, case and skill purchases
plugins.author: Rowan Kavanagh

plugins.name: Auto Forge
plugins.summary: Preview capped forge batches across farm accounts, with an inventory picker and optional Legendary chaining.
plugins.overview: Choose skins from a scan, approve exact inputs, and cap their value and attempts. Chain successful upgrades within your limits.
plugins.integration: Uses Hub routes and a per-exit-IP concurrency limit. Rechecks eligibility and records attempts for Daily Reports.
plugins.operation: Read-only scan and confirmed forge attempts
plugins.author: Rowan Kavanagh

plugins.name: Auto Skin Collection Completer
plugins.summary: Finish named collections or work through everything available from the case shop and Armory.
plugins.overview: Run a single budget-limited batch that opens owned cases first, submits eligible drops and claims rewards. Track completion and spending in live progress bars, and browse all collections by account.
plugins.integration: Requests a handoff from other Hub plugins before writing. Scans matching inventory copies to protect favourites and verifies progress on the approved account route.
plugins.operation: Read-only fleet overview and confirmed one-time runs
plugins.author: Rowan Kavanagh

plugins.name: Auto Trade Favourites
plugins.summary: Send selected farm accounts’ favourites to one collector account.
plugins.overview: Filter by name and value. Bound trade size and reserve receiving capacity.
plugins.integration: Uses Hub trade sockets on both accounts, checks the participants and verifies receipt in inventory.
plugins.operation: Manual preview and optional scheduled runs
plugins.author: Rowan Kavanagh

plugins.name: Auto Sort SU
plugins.summary: Sort farm inventories into storage units with account-specific rules.
plugins.overview: Route 100% Fades, top-ranked floats, specific patterns and favourites by rule priority.
plugins.integration: Reads actual storage capacity and verifies exact items in destination units.
plugins.operation: Manual preview and optional scheduled runs
plugins.author: Rowan Kavanagh

plugins.name: ZSB Hub External Plugin Marketplace
plugins.summary: Browse and install external community plugins from this GitHub repository inside ZSB Hub.
plugins.overview: The External Marketplace lists community ZIPs from GitHub and installs or updates them through the Hub’s ZIP importer.
plugins.integration: Checks package hashes and manifests, then calls the desktop panel’s existing import bridge. Makes no game-site requests.
plugins.operation: Manual update check and confirmed installations
plugins.author: Rowan Kavanagh

plugins.name: Auction Sniper
plugins.summary: Find discounted auctions and place capped autobids from Hub’s main account.
plugins.overview: Preview live auction quotes using ChunkyCheese PriceData and approve a batch. Optional scheduled scanning and autobids.
plugins.integration: Rechecks the seller, lot, main account balance and route. Confirms the site’s autobid receipt.
plugins.operation: Practice preview and optional live bids
plugins.author: Rowan Kavanagh

plugins.name: Farm Value
plugins.summary: Chart the combined inventory, cash and token balances of every Hub account.
plugins.overview: Track ChunkyCheese-priced inventory and storage units alongside cash and converted tokens in a line chart with a combined total.
plugins.integration: Reads balances and inventory through Hub routes and plots saved samples inside the Hub desktop tab.
plugins.author: Rowan Kavanagh

plugins.name: Routed Account Setup
plugins.summary: Create and verify an alt through its farming proxy or WireGuard route. Supports Hub 1.2.8 and 1.2.11.
plugins.overview: Open Farming → Account Setup to complete signup and email verification, then add the account with optional Auto Grind enrollment.
plugins.integration: Uses the official Case Clicker signup in a routed window and saves the account with the selected route pinned.
plugins.operation: Manual signup, verification and account import
plugins.author: Rowan Kavanagh
